provenance.applicabilityNote: Not version-gated at runtime. CombatFight exposes no client-build key, and gameVersion/logVersion are Warcraft Logs parser keys, not the World of Warcraft client build — comparing either against 12.1.0.69587 would be a gate that always passes while appearing rigorous. The build is recorded for traceability; a client build moving is a regeneration trigger for a human, not a runtime condition.

binding.sourceNote: create_action_protection: if ( name == "avenging_wrath" && talents.sentinel->ok() ) return new sentinel_t; sentinel_t( p, options_str ) : paladin_spell_t( "sentinel", p, p->talents.sentinel ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:723, talents.sentinel = find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Sentinel" ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:1074 (trait spell 389539). Otherwise paladin_t::create_action dispatches to avenging_wrath_t( p, options_str ) : paladin_spell_t( "avenging_wrath", p, p->find_spell( 31884 ) ) at sc_paladin.cpp:3381-3382 and 283-284, which sets background = true when the Sentinel talent is taken.

create_action dispatches "divine_toll" to divine_toll_t, whose base is paladin_spell_t( "divine_toll", p, p->talents.divine_toll ) at sc_paladin.cpp:1823; talents.divine_toll = find_talent_spell( talent_tree::CLASS, "Divine Toll" ) at sc_paladin.cpp:4201, whose Protection trait row carries spell 375576.

create_action dispatches "hammer_of_light" to hammer_of_light_t, whose base is holy_power_consumer_t( "hammer_of_light", p, p->spells.templar.hammer_of_light_driver ) at sc_paladin.cpp:2143; spells.templar.hammer_of_light_driver = find_spell( 427453 ) at sc_paladin.cpp:4336.

create_action dispatches "shield_of_the_righteous" to shield_of_the_righteous_t, whose base is holy_power_consumer_t( "shield_of_the_righteous", p, p->spec.shield_of_the_righteous ) at sc_paladin.cpp:2902; spec.shield_of_the_righteous = find_class_spell( "Shield of the Righteous" ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:1106. class_spells.inc row { 2, 0, 53600 } confirms the id.

create_action dispatches "holy_armaments" to holy_armaments_t, whose base is paladin_spell_t( "holy_armaments", p, p->find_spell( 432459 ) ) at sc_paladin.cpp:2616. The DBC record is named "Holy Bulwark"; the token is the Lightsmith armament action, background unless the Lightsmith hero tree is active (sc_paladin.cpp:2621).

create_action dispatches "hammer_of_wrath" for PALADIN_PROTECTION to hammer_of_wrath_t( this, "hammer_of_wrath", options_str, find_spell( 1241413 ) ). The Retribution branch (24275) is a different record and is not a candidate for this specialization.

create_action dispatches "judgment" for PALADIN_PROTECTION to judgment_t( this, "judgment", options_str, find_spell( 275779 ) ). class_spells.inc row { 2, 66, 275779 } confirms the id as the Protection Judgment.

create_action_protection dispatches "avengers_shield" to avengers_shield_t, whose base avengers_shield_base_t is paladin_spell_t( n, p, p->find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Avenger's Shield" ) ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:171; the Protection trait row carries spell 31935.

create_action dispatches "consecration" to consecration_t, whose base is paladin_spell_t( "consecration", p, p->find_spell( 26573 ) ) at sc_paladin.cpp:425. class_spells.inc row { 2, 0, 26573 } confirms the id.

create_action_protection dispatches "hammer_of_the_righteous" to hammer_of_the_righteous_t, whose base is paladin_melee_attack_t( "hammer_of_the_righteous", p, p->find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Hammer of the Righteous" ) ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:608; the trait row carries spell 53595. The action is background when the Blessed Hammer talent is taken (sc_paladin_protection.cpp:612-613).

create_action_protection dispatches "blessed_hammer" to blessed_hammer_t, whose base is paladin_spell_t( "blessed_hammer", p, p->talents.blessed_hammer ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:407; talents.blessed_hammer = find_talent_spell( SPECIALIZATION, "Blessed Hammer" ) at sc_paladin_protection.cpp:1026, whose trait row carries spell 204019.

player_t::create_action dispatches "arcane_torrent" to arcane_torrent_t, whose base is racial_spell_t( p, "arcane_torrent", p->find_racial_spell( "Arcane Torrent" ) ) at player.cpp:9050-9051. racial_spells.inc carries nine Arcane Torrent rows selected by class mask; the row whose class mask is 0x00000002 (Paladin) is { 0x0200 (Blood Elf), 0x00000002, 155145 }. Only that row can resolve for a Paladin, so it is the single candidate.

create_action dispatches "word_of_glory" to word_of_glory_t( this, options_str, "word_of_glory" ), whose base is holy_power_consumer_t( name, p, p->find_class_spell( "Word of Glory" ) ) at sc_paladin.cpp:1218. class_spells.inc row { 2, 0, 85673 } confirms the id.

player_t::create_action dispatches "fireblood" to fireblood_t, whose base is racial_spell_t( p, "fireblood", p->find_racial_spell( "Fireblood" ) ) at player.cpp:9400-9401. racial_spells.inc: { 0x0800 (Dark Iron Dwarf), 0x3fff, 265221, "Fireblood" }.

auto_melee_attack_t's constructor (struct opens at sc_paladin.cpp:1024) is built on spell_data_t::nil() and assigns trigger_gcd = 0_ms. No spell record backs the APL token; its ready() is `!is_moving() && main_hand_attack->execute_event == nullptr` (sc_paladin.cpp:1046-1052).
use_item_t's constructor (struct opens at player.cpp:9847) assigns trigger_gcd = timespan_t::zero(). No spell record backs the APL token.
use_items_t's constructor (struct opens at player.cpp:10216) assigns trigger_gcd = timespan_t::zero(). It is the foreground entry; its per-slot sub-actions are internal.

potion_t (consumable.cpp:428) derives from dbc_consumable_base_t, whose constructor (consumable.cpp:791) assigns trigger_gcd = timespan_t::zero(). The lane therefore holds for EVERY potion identity; Warcraft Logs supplies no player level to pick one.
